common_parameters.name: INTENSITY
common_parameters.description: Effect strength / how much it replaces the background

common_parameters.name: OPACITY
common_parameters.description: Effect opacity over transparent terminal backgrounds

common_parameters.name: READABILITY
common_parameters.description: Text protection: luminance cap and halo behind glyphs

common_parameters.name: DISTORT_TEXT
common_parameters.description: Allow the effect to displace terminal text

common_parameters.name: COLORSPACE_FALLBACK
common_parameters.description: Colour space assumed when auto-detection is ambiguous

shaders.name: Alien Interface
shaders.description: An extraterrestrial HUD: rotating segmented rings, scrolling glyph columns and a faint hex lattice in sickly green.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Alien Language
shaders.description: Columns of curving, unreadable glyphs assemble stroke by stroke, glow, then dissolve into new symbols.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Alien Planet
shaders.description: A teal-and-rose alien sky with two moons and a ringed giant, above layered jagged ridges and drifting spores.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Alien Radar
shaders.description: A hexagonal scope with three rotating sweeps, leaving fading trails and blips of unknown contacts.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Alien Technology
shaders.description: Curving Truchet circuitry of unknown design, with violet and green pulses chasing each other through it.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Biomechanical
shaders.description: Tangled tubes of bone and bronze knotted into a single surface, lit by a slow-moving lamp.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cosmic Organism
shaders.description: Translucent bioluminescent cells drift and jostle, each with a glowing membrane and pulsing nucleus.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Extraterrestrial Portal
shaders.description: An unstable alien gateway: a crackling elliptical rim spits tendrils of energy around a churning green interior.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Extraterrestrial Signal
shaders.description: A radio telescope readout of a strange transmission: glowing waveform traces over a scrolling spectrogram.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Holographic Scanner
shaders.description: A cyan scan beam sweeps the screen, briefly revealing a measurement grid and lighting up the text as it passes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: UFO Energy
shaders.description: A tractor beam pours down from above, rings of energy pulsing along it inside a shimmering haze.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Xenomorph Atmosphere
shaders.description: A dark, wet biomechanical hive: ribbed walls glisten in the gloom and slowly breathe.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Amber Terminal
shaders.description: A warm amber monochrome monitor whose slow phosphor leaves a faint smear trailing below the text.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: SMEAR
parameters.description: Afterglow smear strength (approximation, no frame feedback)

shaders.name: Blue Phosphor
shaders.description: Cold blue-white monochrome phosphor with a fine dot mask and the faintest horizontal sync jitter.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Classic CRT
shaders.description: A flat, well-adjusted CRT: crisp scanlines, a faint aperture grille, soft glow and gently darkened corners.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT Arcade
shaders.description: A punchy arcade cabinet monitor: saturated colours, chunky shadow mask, mild curve and a bezel lit by the screen.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT Bloom
shaders.description: Soft, generous phosphor glow: bright text spills light into the surrounding glass, over faint scanlines.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT Broken
shaders.description: A dying monitor: misconverged colour guns, magnetised purity blotches, a dark band and the vertical hold slipping.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT Flicker
shaders.description: An ageing tube: a subtle unsteady brightness and a soft refresh band that rolls slowly down the screen.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT Glitch
shaders.description: A dependable CRT that every few seconds suffers a brief burst of torn lines, colour fringing and block noise.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: RATE
parameters.description: Chance of a glitch in each one-second slot

shaders.name: CRT Interlaced
shaders.description: Alternating odd and even fields with a soft half-line offset, the shimmer of an interlaced broadcast monitor.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT RGB Mask
shaders.description: A close-up of the tube: clearly resolved red, green and blue phosphor triads with scanline gaps.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT Static
shaders.description: A weak analog signal: crawling snow, faint diagonal interference and a picture that fades in and out of the noise.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: CRT Terminal 1980
shaders.description: A 1980s video terminal in pale P4 white: deep tube curvature, glassy reflection, and a power-on warm-up each time it gains focus.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: WARMUP
parameters.description: Play the power-on animation when focused

shaders.name: CRT VHS
shaders.description: Worn videotape playback: bleeding colour, wobbling lines, tape noise and a tracking band drifting up the screen.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Curved CRT
shaders.description: The terminal bulges out of a rounded tube in a dark bezel, with scanlines that follow the glass curvature.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Green Phosphor
shaders.description: Everything rendered as glowing P1 green phosphor on black, with scanlines and a warm halo around each glyph.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cyber Rain
shaders.description: Rain falls through neon light: streaks pick up pink and cyan from blurred signs, splashing on a wet reflective street.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cybernetic HUD
shaders.description: An augmented-reality overlay: corner brackets, a scrolling compass tape, a slow reticle and live telemetry bars.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cyberpunk City
shaders.description: A rain-hazed neon skyline: layered towers with flickering windows, glowing signs and air traffic gliding between them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Digital Tunnel
shaders.description: Racing down a square data tunnel: grid-lined walls, rushing light streaks and a glowing exit far ahead.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Neon Grid
shaders.description: An endless glowing grid floor rushes toward you under a dark horizon haze, pure retro-futurism.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Neon Pulse
shaders.description: A neon tube traces the edge of the window, breathing in brightness with the occasional sign-like flicker.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: INSET
parameters.description: Distance of the tube from the edge

shaders.name: Purple Cyberspace
shaders.description: Drifting through a violet data dimension: grid floor and ceiling, purple fog, and wireframe data cubes slowly spinning.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Retrowave
shaders.description: Stacked neon waveforms ripple across the screen like an 80s oscilloscope album cover, hot pink fading into cyan.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Synthwave Sunset
shaders.description: A huge striped sun sinks behind wireframe mountains while a magenta grid scrolls toward the viewer.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Electric Arcs
shaders.description: Crackling arcs leap between pairs of electrodes, each discharge a jittering bundle of hot filaments.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Electric Blue
shaders.description: A field of thin, writhing blue energy filaments that crackle across the whole background.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Electric Circuit
shaders.description: A green circuit board with copper traces, gold pads and vias, as cyan signals pulse along the tracks.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Electric Purple
shaders.description: Violet currents crawl sideways across the screen in braided bands, flaring wherever strands cross.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Electric Storm
shaders.description: Towering storm clouds flicker from within as sheet lightning crawls through them, over driving rain.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Electromagnetic Field
shaders.description: Field lines and equipotential contours flow around drifting positive and negative charges.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Energy Shield
shaders.description: A hexagonal force field hums across the window; impacts ripple out and light up the cells they cross.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Ionized Plasma
shaders.description: Glowing ionised gas churns in teal and magenta, threaded with crackling discharge filaments.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Lightning
shaders.description: Forked lightning tears down from dark clouds every few seconds, briefly lighting the whole sky.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Neon Current
shaders.description: Smooth neon tubes snake across the screen while bright pulses of current flow along them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Power Grid
shaders.description: A network of substations and transmission lines, with packets of energy hopping from node to node.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Tesla Coil
shaders.description: A Tesla coil's toroid throws branching purple-white streamers into the air in a constant buzzing crackle.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Blue Fire
shaders.description: A row of roaring gas-burner jets in electric blue, each with a white-cyan core and crackling tips.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: JETS
parameters.description: Number of jets across a 16:9 screen

shaders.name: Campfire Embers
shaders.description: Glowing embers float up from an unseen campfire, swaying and flickering out in the cool night air.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Green Fire
shaders.description: Supernatural green flames creep in from every edge of the window, curling into ghostly wisps.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: REACH
parameters.description: How far flames reach in from the edges

shaders.name: Heat Haze
shaders.description: Rising thermal shimmer wobbles the bottom of the terminal like air over hot asphalt, with a faint amber glow.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: REACH
parameters.description: How far up the screen the haze rises

shaders.name: Hellfire
shaders.description: An infernal sea of churning red fire and black smoke, with embers spiralling up through the gloom.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Inferno
shaders.description: A firestorm vortex: spiralling arms of flame converge on a blinding core at the centre of the screen.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Lava Flow
shaders.description: Slow rivers of molten rock: dark cooling crust plates drift apart over glowing orange cracks.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Molten Core
shaders.description: Cracked black rock with a branching network of white-hot fissures that pulse with heat and shimmer the air.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Plasma Field
shaders.description: Shimmering sheets of magenta and cyan energy plasma, folding through each other with bright filaments.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Purple Fire
shaders.description: A line of violet torches burning across the bottom of the screen, their flames swaying and lighting the dark above.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Realistic Fire
shaders.description: A wall of turbulent flames licking up from the bottom of the screen, with a white-hot base and smoky tips.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: HEIGHT
parameters.description: Flame height as a fraction of the screen

shaders.name: Solar Flare
shaders.description: The boiling limb of a star rises from the bottom edge, its granulated surface throwing looping plasma prominences.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Fractal Zoom
shaders.description: An endless dive into the Mandelbrot set's Seahorse Valley, spirals unfolding into ever-smaller spirals.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
known_limitations: 32-bit floats limit the zoom depth; the dive loops every cycle with a cross-fade.

shaders.name: Hexagonal Grid
shaders.description: Bevelled hexagon tiles rise and fall in rolling waves, their tops catching the light as the wave passes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Infinite Tunnel
shaders.description: The classic demoscene tunnel: a twisting checkerboard tube rushing toward a vanishing point.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Julia Set
shaders.description: A Julia fractal that continually morphs as its parameter traces the edge of the Mandelbrot cardioid.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Kaleidoscope
shaders.description: Coloured shards tumble inside mirrored wedges, folding into an ever-changing symmetric mandala.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Mandelbrot
shaders.description: The whole Mandelbrot set, smoothly shaded, with colour bands flowing outward from its boundary.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Sacred Geometry
shaders.description: A golden Flower of Life with Metatron-style lines and slowly counter-rotating rings, drawn in fine glowing strokes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Voronoi
shaders.description: Softly coloured Voronoi cells drift and reshape, their borders glowing where neighbours meet.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cracked Glass
shaders.description: A pane struck in one spot: radial and ring fractures catch the light, and each shard sits slightly askew.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Frosted Glass
shaders.description: A frosted pane over soft drifting colour blobs, with fine grain and a bright bevel along the window edge.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
known_limitations: Ghostty cannot see the desktop behind the window, so the "backdrop" is procedural.

shaders.name: Glass Distortion
shaders.description: Looking through an antique hand-made pane: gentle waves, trapped bubbles and a faint colour fringe that drift as you watch.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Glass Prism
shaders.description: A white beam enters a glass prism at the edge of the screen and fans out into a slowly turning rainbow.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Glass Ripples
shaders.description: Reeded, fluted glass: vertical ribs slice and refract soft colours drifting behind them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Glass Shimmer
shaders.description: Soft iridescent highlights drift across a pane of glass like light catching it as you move.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Glossy Reflection
shaders.description: A glossy screen: a broad diagonal sheen glides slowly across, with a faint reflected room gradient behind it.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Holographic Glass
shaders.description: Translucent sci-fi panels float at different depths, edged in light and washed with a shifting iridescent sheen.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Ice Glass
shaders.description: Frost crystals creep in from the corners of an icy pane, feathery and glittering, then slowly melt back.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: CYCLE
parameters.description: Seconds for frost to grow and recede

shaders.name: Liquid Glass
shaders.description: Blobs of clear liquid glass drift and merge over the terminal, magnifying what lies beneath with bright refractive rims.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Mirror Surface
shaders.description: The lower part of the window turns into a dark polished floor that mirrors the terminal above, rippling gently.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: HORIZON
parameters.description: Height of the mirror line (fraction of screen from the bottom)

shaders.name: Rainy Window
shaders.description: A fogged-up window on a rainy evening: beaded droplets cling to the glass and warm lights glow beyond.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Broken GPU
shaders.description: Simulated driver meltdown: stretched texture stripes, checkerboard tiles and spiky wrong-colour polygons that come and go.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Compression Artifacts
shaders.description: An over-compressed video stream: 8x8 block averaging, posterised banding and ringing around sharp edges.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: QUALITY_LOSS
parameters.description: How badly the image is compressed

shaders.name: Corrupted Memory
shaders.description: The background becomes a live memory dump: bit-pattern blocks flip and decay, and now and then a cell inverts.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cyber Glitch
shaders.description: Neon magenta and cyan glitch slices tear across a dark synth grid, as if the terminal is being hacked.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Datamosh
shaders.description: Video-codec meltdown: macroblocks smear along stale motion vectors and colour bleeds between neighbouring blocks.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Digital Glitch
shaders.description: Sudden horizontal slices of the screen jump sideways in quantised steps, with a hint of colour separation.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Glitch Rain
shaders.description: Shards of colour-split static fall like rain behind the text, each fragment flickering as it drops.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Hologram Glitch
shaders.description: The whole terminal becomes a flickering cyan hologram: rolling scan bands, jitter and a ghostly transparency.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Reality Break
shaders.description: The screen shatters into drifting Voronoi shards with glowing seams, each tilted and colour-split as space comes apart.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: RGB Split
shaders.description: Red, green and blue channels drift apart toward the screen edges, rotating slowly like a misaligned lens.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: AMOUNT
parameters.description: Channel separation at the edges in pixels (at 1440p)

parameters.name: CENTER
parameters.description: How much the centre is spared

shaders.name: Screen Tear
shaders.description: A vsync failure: a tear line sweeps down the screen, with the image above it sheared sideways.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: SHEAR
parameters.description: Horizontal offset above the tear (fraction of width)

shaders.name: Signal Interference
shaders.description: Electronic interference: wavy horizontal distortion, tinted noise bars and brief signal dropouts.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Lava Lamp
shaders.description: Slow blobs of glowing wax rise, stretch, merge and sink through warm liquid, just like the 70s classic.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Liquid Gradient
shaders.description: A soft mesh gradient of four drifting colour pools, gently warped, like a modern app background in slow motion.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Metaballs
shaders.description: Neon-outlined organic blobs merge and split, colours blending by each blob's influence, with ghost contour rings around them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Psychedelic Waves
shaders.description: Saturated bands of colour pour and fold through each other in hypnotic interference patterns.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Hacker Terminal
shaders.description: A dark ops console: faint scanlines, a slowly rolling scan bar, hex readouts ghosting in the margins and a phosphor glow on the text.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Matrix Rain
shaders.description: Columns of glowing green glyphs cascade down the screen behind the text, each column with its own speed and bright leading character.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Purple Matrix
shaders.description: A violet take on digital rain using katakana-like strokes, with depth: near columns large and bright, far ones small and dim.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Brushed Steel
shaders.description: Horizontally brushed stainless steel with fine streaks and a soft anisotropic highlight that slides with the light.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Carbon Fiber
shaders.description: Glossy 2x2 twill carbon weave, its tows catching a slow sweep of light under a clear coat.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Chrome
shaders.description: A slab of mirror-polished chrome with embossed ripples, reflecting a high-contrast sky and dark horizon.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Copper Metal
shaders.description: Hammered copper: dimpled facets glint with warm light, with verdigris patina settling into the seams.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Gold Metal
shaders.description: Softly undulating polished gold, its warm reflections and crisp highlights rolling as the light moves.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Iridescent Metal
shaders.description: Heat-tinted metal like bismuth or anodised titanium, thin-film colours sliding across its surface.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Liquid Metal
shaders.description: Pools of mercury bulge, merge and split across the screen, mirroring a bright studio around them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Machinery
shaders.description: Interlocking gears turn at correct ratios in a dim engine room, their teeth catching the light.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Metallic Waves
shaders.description: A sheet of liquid silver rolls in long silky waves, catching bands of light along every crest.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Molten Metal
shaders.description: Streams of incandescent liquid metal pour and braid across the screen, cooling to a dark sheen at their edges.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Rusted Steel
shaders.description: Weathered steel plate: orange rust blooms, pitting and streaks that run down from rivets, creeping slowly over time.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Titanium
shaders.description: Dark machined titanium with a fine bead-blasted grain, broad soft reflections and a hint of anodised colour.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Beacon Beam
shaders.description: A brilliant cyan beam shoots straight up through the night, banded with rising light and surrounded by floating motes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft's beacon (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Enchantment Table
shaders.description: Arcane glyphs peel off the air and drift in curving paths toward a glowing book at the bottom of the screen.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft's enchanting table particles (original glyph generator, no game assets)

shaders.name: End Dimension
shaders.description: A pale blocky island floats in an endless dark void, ringed by distant pillars and drifting purple particles.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft's End dimension (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Ender Portal
shaders.description: Parallax layers of drifting teal and violet specks over a black void, an original take on the End portal surface.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft's End portal block (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Experience Orbs
shaders.description: Bobbing pixel orbs shimmer between lime and gold, drifting together like they are being collected.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft experience orbs (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Nether Atmosphere
shaders.description: Thick crimson fog rolls beneath a blocky rock ceiling while embers drift up from a lava sea glowing below.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft's Nether (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Nether Portal
shaders.description: A swirling sheet of violet dimensional energy rendered in chunky pixels, framed by obsidian blocks.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: PIXELS
parameters.description: Pixel rows across the screen height

shaders.attribution: Minecraft's nether portal (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Obsidian Crystals
shaders.description: Glassy black-violet crystal facets catch a slowly circling light, with sparks of purple glinting across them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft obsidian (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Pixelated Rain
shaders.description: Chunky retro raindrops fall in pixel columns from blocky clouds and splash into tiny pixel bursts at the bottom.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: PIXELS
parameters.description: Pixel rows across the screen height

shaders.attribution: Minecraft's blocky weather (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Redstone Pulse
shaders.description: Glowing red wiring snakes across a stone floor, with signal pulses racing outward from powered sources.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft redstone dust (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Sculk Energy
shaders.description: Deep-dark organic veins throb with cyan light as vibration rings ripple out from hidden sensors.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft's sculk blocks (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Soul Fire
shaders.description: Pixelated pale-blue flames flicker along the bottom while ghostly soul wisps rise slowly through the gloom.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
shaders.attribution: Minecraft's soul fire (original procedural interpretation, no game assets)

shaders.name: Blizzard
shaders.description: Wind-driven snow streaks sideways through a white-out, visibility rising and falling with each gust.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Clouds
shaders.description: Puffy sunlit cumulus drift across a blue sky, self-shadowed so they look solid and three-dimensional.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Desert Heat
shaders.description: Sun-bleached dunes under a white-hot sky, with a shimmering mirage pooling on the horizon and wobbling the air.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Fog
shaders.description: Layers of soft grey fog drift slowly sideways at different speeds. Quiet and very easy on the eyes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Forest Light
shaders.description: Sunbeams slant down between tall trunks in a green forest, dust motes drifting slowly through the light.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Misty Mountains
shaders.description: Ridge after ridge of mountains fade into blue haze, with bands of mist drifting slowly between them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Moonlight
shaders.description: A full moon glows through thin, slowly drifting clouds that light up silver as they pass in front of it.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Northern Lights
shaders.description: Green and violet aurora curtains ripple across a starry sky above a silhouetted pine forest.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: HEIGHT
parameters.description: Height of the aurora base above the horizon

shaders.name: Rainstorm
shaders.description: Heavy rain in deep layers, near drops blurred and fast, with splashes rippling across puddles below.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Sunrise
shaders.description: Dawn breaks over rolling hills: the sky warms from deep blue to gold as the sun slowly climbs, again and again.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Sunset
shaders.description: A warm sun sinks into a calm sea, painting the undersides of the clouds pink and laying a golden path on the water.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Thunderstorm
shaders.description: A storm front over dark hills: heavy clouds, grey veils of rain sweeping across, and distant bolts striking the ground.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Bioluminescent Ocean
shaders.description: Night surf where every breaking wave stirs up glowing blue plankton that sparkle and fade in its wake.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Deep Ocean
shaders.description: The view from far below the surface: shafts of light fading into the abyss and drifting marine snow.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Liquid Surface
shaders.description: A glossy, ink-dark liquid seen from above, slowly undulating while two lights slide across its reflective skin.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Ocean at Night
shaders.description: A dark sea under a full moon, its silver glitter path breaking up across slow black swells.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Ocean Waves
shaders.description: Rolling open-ocean swells seen from just above the water, with sky reflections and a low sun glinting on the crests.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Rain on Glass
shaders.description: Rivulets of rain racing down the pane in stop-start runs, refracting a blurred night city behind the text.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Stormy Sea
shaders.description: Heavy grey-green swells capped with foam under racing storm clouds, rain streaks and the odd distant flash.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Tropical Water
shaders.description: Looking down on a turquoise lagoon: sandy shallows, rippling caustics, foam lapping at the shore and sun sparkles.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Underwater Caustics
shaders.description: Sunlight focused by a moving water surface into a bright, shifting net on a sandy pool floor.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Water Refraction
shaders.description: The terminal seen through a thin layer of moving water: a gentle wobble with soft light beneath.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Water Ripples
shaders.description: Raindrop-like ripples bloom at random points on a dark, still pond and spread out in widening rings.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Waterfall
shaders.description: A tall curtain of falling water between dark cliffs, with white streaks, spray and mist boiling up from the pool.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

parameters.name: WIDTH
parameters.description: Width of the falls (fraction of screen height units)

shaders.name: Ashfall
shaders.description: Grey volcanic ash flutters down through a smoky, ember-tinted sky.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cherry Blossoms
shaders.description: Pink sakura petals with notched tips float on a spring breeze across a soft dusk gradient.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Digital Particles
shaders.description: Tiny pixel-font ones and zeros rise like bubbles through a dark field, flickering between states.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Falling Leaves
shaders.description: Autumn leaves tumble and flip as they drift down through warm late-afternoon light.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Fireflies
shaders.description: Fireflies wander over a dusky meadow, each blinking on its own slow rhythm above silhouetted grass.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Floating Particles
shaders.description: Soft out-of-focus orbs drift upward on several depth planes, like dust caught in a beam of light.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Magic Dust
shaders.description: A ribbon of golden sparkles winds across the screen, each glint flaring into a four-pointed star.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Particle Trails
shaders.description: Bright points race along looping orbits, leaving long smooth light trails that fade behind them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Particle Vortex
shaders.description: Thousands of motes spiral into a central drain, orbiting faster the closer they get.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Quantum Particles
shaders.description: Fuzzy probability clouds flicker in and out of existence while entangled pairs pulse in sync over interference fringes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Snowfall
shaders.description: Quiet snow falling in layers through a blue winter night, near flakes large and soft, far ones fine and slow.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Star Dust
shaders.description: Multicoloured cosmic dust drifts slowly through faint nebular haze, twinkling as it passes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Dimensional Rift
shaders.description: A jagged tear in space splits the screen, glowing at its ragged edges with another dimension churning inside.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Dream Portal
shaders.description: A soft arched doorway opens onto pastel clouds, with bubbles drifting out into a hazy lilac evening.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Quantum Gateway
shaders.description: Nested polygons rotate at quantised rates around a bright singular point, wrapped in shimmering interference fringes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Reality Warp
shaders.description: Invisible masses drift across the window, pinching and swirling the fabric of space and the text along with it.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Time Vortex
shaders.description: A spiralling temporal tunnel lined with clock-face rings, each ticking at its own pace as they recede.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Void Portal
shaders.description: Purple light spirals into a portal of absolute black, banded rings pulled ever inward toward nothing.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Accretion Disk
shaders.description: A tilted disk of white-hot gas whirls around a black hole, one side Doppler-brightened, its far side lensed into an arc overhead.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Aurora from Orbit
shaders.description: Seen from orbit, green and violet auroral curtains ripple above the curved night side of a planet.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Black Hole
shaders.description: A black hole bends the starfield and nebula behind it into an Einstein ring around a perfectly dark shadow.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Cosmic Dust
shaders.description: Soft veils of interstellar dust drift across a sparse starfield on several parallax layers. Very calm.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Event Horizon
shaders.description: The curved edge of an enormous black hole fills the bottom of the screen, starlight smeared into arcs along its rim.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Meteor Shower
shaders.description: Shooting stars streak across a clear night sky above a dark treeline, bright heads trailing glowing tails.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Nebula
shaders.description: Billowing clouds of glowing gas in magenta, teal and gold, laced with dark dust and embedded young stars.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Planetary Rings
shaders.description: Sweeping close-up of a ringed giant: hundreds of fine ringlets, gaps, and the planet's shadow falling across them.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Pulsar
shaders.description: A spinning neutron star sweeps twin lighthouse beams across space inside a cage of magnetic field loops.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Quasar
shaders.description: A blazing galactic core fires two knotted relativistic jets into space, its glare split by diffraction spikes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Spiral Galaxy
shaders.description: A tilted spiral galaxy turns slowly: a golden bulge, blue star-forming arms and dark dust lanes.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Starfield
shaders.description: A calm flight through deep space: stars of different colours and depths slide past and grow as they approach.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Supernova
shaders.description: A star detonates: a blinding core gives way to an expanding shell of filaments that fades before the next blast.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Warp Speed
shaders.description: The jump to hyperspace: star streaks stretch radially from a bright vanishing point and rush past the edges.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors

shaders.name: Wormhole
shaders.description: Falling down a tunnel through spacetime: nebular walls stream past toward a bright far opening.
shaders.author: GhostFX Contributors
